row.notes: Lazily builds a static hash set (0x146ca7208) of 15 code points: U+3001, U+3002, ',', '.', U+FF0C, U+FF01, U+FF1F, U+FF1A, U+FF1B, U+FF5E, U+FF09, U+FF3D, U+FF5D, U+FF60, U+FF63. Decodes one UTF-8 code point (2 to 4 byte lead handling, 0xa0 special case), FNV-1a hashes its 4 bytes and returns whether it is in the set. These are closing punctuation marks, so it is most likely the no-line-start (kinsoku) test for wrapping.
